Most of the passengers were Israeli and were later flown from Saudi Arabia to Israel. Oman does not have diplomatic relations with Israel. According to the report, rules introduced after 2020 Abraham Accords prohibit pilots from countries that do not have relations with Israel from flying into the country.

title: India explode in 2nd half, crush Malaysia 5-1 to retain Asian Games gold; seal LA28 spot
content: India had never won successive Asian Games gold medals, making Saturday's final an opportunity to create history. Harmanpreet Singh-led India made the most of it as they successfully defended their title.

title: Ukraine confirms India playing big role in mediating energy truce in Black Sea
content: Ukraine has expressed readiness to explore India's comprehensive proposal for ending the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict. During recent communications, Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha emphasized the importance of India's mediation role. India's external affairs minister S Jaishankar affirmed continuous engagement with both Kyiv and Moscow regarding potential solutions. Ukraine is open to discussing limited ceasefire arrangements around energy infrastructure and safe Black Sea shipping.

title: Congress resets Team UP: 5 clear messages for BJP and Akhilesh Yadav

The Congress reshuffle brings Brahmin, Muslim, OBC, Dalit and women representation into its leadership team, signalling a push to rebuild its organisation, expand its social base and strengthen its position in talks with Samajwadi Party.

title: What took 10 Google engineers six months now happens overnight, says Eric Schmidt
content: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt says the best programmers no longer write code. Speaking at Harvard's John F. Kennedy Jr. Forum, Schmidt described an engineer who writes specifications and evaluation criteria, lets AI run overnight, and wakes up to finished work. He argued AI will make top engineers more valuable, automate core business operations like billing and logistics, and predicted artificial general intelligence (AGI) could arrive as early as 2029.

title: Maryland homeowner gets $234,368 check for home; new law bans such offers
content: Effective October 1, Maryland introduced legislation banning unsolicited checks sent with home purchase offers. This initiative is designed to safeguard homeowners from misleading marketing strategies from property investors. Consumer advocates highlighted the risk of vulnerable owners being tricked into agreements upon receiving such checks. Historical precedents in consumer lending underline the necessity for legal protections, advising homeowners against accepting random financial items received through mail.

title: 'Dragged to basement, assaulted': 7 held after woman partially stripped at nightclub
content: Seven individuals, including a nightclub manager, were arrested following an incident of assault at The Locals nightclub. The incident occurred after a drunken altercation where a woman was reportedly assaulted by bouncers. Police conducted an investigation after receiving information about the assault and reviewed CCTV footage from the nightclub. A video circulating on social media showed the woman being assaulted, leading to police action.

title: Snap, clap, twirl into the garba spirit
content: NCR residents are preparing for the upcoming Navratri celebration by attending garba and raas workshops. These classes welcome participants of various backgrounds to embrace the cultural experience together. Instructors aim to balance traditional steps with simpler movements for inclusivity. Many attendees find emotional and physical benefits from participating in these dance sessions. Learning garba offers both a meaningful workout and a way to connect with one's cultural roots.

title: South Africa fossils include 2-million-year-old adult Homo erectus
content: Researchers have described 18 previously unpublished hominin fossils from South Africa, including an adultHomo erectusfossil dated to 2 million years ago. The findings support the species’ first appearance in southern Africa at that time and provide evidence of microevolution inP. robustus.

title: MacKenzie Scott gave $30M to housing nonprofit; a year later, it unveiled 10-year plan
content: MacKenzie Scott has made headlines with her unprecedented $30 million donation to Housing Trust Silicon Valley, marking the organization's largest-ever gift. This investment is set to bolster affordable housing options throughout the Bay Area, as the trust plans to enhance its loan fund and expand various housing initiatives over the next decade.

title: Ohio girl raised $768 at lemonade stand; 8 years later, nonprofit topped $5 million
content: After her time at Cincinnati Children's Hospital, Payton Obert initiated a lemonade stand to assist children in distress. What started as a simple venture has evolved into Payton's Lemonade Stand, amassing over $5 million for various children's charities. The nonprofit not only supplies toys and necessary items to kids facing illness but also encourages community participation, proving that even small gestures can spark tremendous positive impacts.

title: Buried for 120 yrs, fraying paper puts Bhander’s railway dream back on track
content: An old document proposing a railway line between Jhansi and Bhind has been rediscovered. This has spurred local residents to campaign for improved railway connectivity in Bhander. Traders and community members believe the railway could enhance commercial opportunities in the area. They are actively organizing meetings to mobilize support and raise awareness of their initiative. The campaign is being presented as a citizen-driven effort, free from political affiliations.

title: Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes' 1587 restaurant lawsuit takes new turn

title: How Maria Sharapova built a $220 million fortune beyond tennis

Her estimated $220 million fortune has been tied to career earnings, global endorsements, Sugarpova and investments in consumer, wellness, fitness and technology companies, allowing the five-time Grand Slam champion to build a financial portfolio outside of professional tennis.

title: Delhi-NCR housing prices rise 12% in Q3, highest among top seven cities: Report
content: Housing prices in the Delhi-NCR region increased by 12 percent annually during the July-September quarter. This rise surpassed the collective annual increase of 7 percent seen in India's top seven cities. Higher input costs and a focus on luxury projects contributed to the price growth in residential properties. Despite a slight moderation in sales, housing demand remained robust in well-connected areas.

title: India unlikely to face food, fertiliser crisis despite global headwinds: Report
content: India's Finance Commission chairman, Arvind Panagariya, indicated that the nation is well-prepared for potential food or fertiliser issues. He emphasized that India's fertiliser supply has been strengthened through domestic production and imports from various countries. Additionally, the country has managed to cope with energy shocks and uncertainties arising from conflicts in West Asia. Panagariya noted that if Ukraine's exports decline, demand for Indian food products might increase.

title: Delhi landfill garbage mountains shrinking, 100 acres reclaimed in 18 months: CM Gupta

The government has successfully reclaimed land and aims to eliminate existing garbage mountains while managing fresh waste effectively. New waste processing facilities have been inaugurated at Okhla, Ghazipur, and Singhola, each designed to process thousands of metric tonnes daily.

title: Pakistan kills 5 TTP militants as violence escalates on Afghanistan border

This mission was executed based on critical intelligence that pinpointed various militant hideouts. Alongside this successful strike, the forces seized a substantial arsenal of weapons and ammunition. This action is a response to the recent surge in violence linked to the TTP, emphasizing the military's ongoing commitment to combatting terrorism in the region.

title: Rate hike may hurt select NBFC segments, but broad asset stress unlikely: Report

The report indicates that past rate increases did not lead to widespread deterioration. Current risks, including the West Asia conflict, appear limited to specific NBFC segments. Healthy capital buffers and liquidity may support overall asset quality for most NBFCs. Any future deterioration is expected to be specific, contingent on external shocks.

title: Massive traffic jams hit Himachal, Uttarakhand on long weekend

Major thoroughfares leading to destinations such as Manali, Shimla, and Mussoorie were notably jammed. In Uttarakhand, the pathways to Badrinath and Kedarnath were clogged with long vehicle queues. Officials indicated that pilgrims faced wait periods of one to three hours, leading to the deployment of traffic management teams to help alleviate the bottlenecks safely.

title: Telangana tops nation in alcohol use, 44% of men report drinking
content: Telangana has the highest alcohol consumption rates among large states in India, with nearly 44% of men reporting use. This figure is significantly higher than the national average of about 19%. There is a notable rural-urban divide, as 46.6% of rural men consume alcohol compared to 36.3% in urban areas. Additionally, around 7.1% of women in Telangana also reported alcohol consumption.
